One real committed WAV fixture (tests/fixtures/audio/synthetic_pause_correction.wav, script 'Book Tuesday. [1.5s pause] Actually, Wednesday at five.', see docs/feedback/PROVENANCE.md) replaces the two scripted transcript events. The script never states AM/PM, so this oracle intentionally does not assert an hour value; the committed hour is real ASR/model-dependent evidence, reported but not scored. Requires --components local --asr-model-path <installed Faster Whisper base.en directory> for a live run; offline-fake mode has no scripted proposals for this file on purpose, so it fails loudly instead of silently substituting a transcript for ASR.
